integrity: All-size PPT-mixture nonmembership is proved using the rank-two support and the two-qubit PPT equivalence in every cut. The exact partial-transpose block determinant is derived symbolically; finite computation is corroborative only. Established qualitative rank-two NPT results are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The claim covers exactly one ideal-or-absent hyperedge gate acting on an initially product plus state, with its flag discarded. It does not extend to multi-edge gate ensembles, physical gate noise, white noise, leakage, or experimentally finite detection precision.
title: Exact PPT-mixture rigidity of a randomized single hyperedge
